R1.title: Playback grant scope and purpose lock; fail closed on missing/disabled user; reject Bearer auth
R1.resolution: Locked JwtUtils.validateJwtToken to reject tokens with type=playback_grant or purpose=playback. Enforced assetId matching in JwtUtils.validatePlaybackGrant. Restricted JwtAuthenticationFilter to accept grants strictly on GET/HEAD requests to /api/media/stream/{assetId} via query parameter. Enforced fail-closed behavior requiring userDetails.isEnabled() and userDetails.isAccountNonLocked().

R2.title: Auth storage key parity; abort in-flight fetch on asset change; clear warning on grant failure
R2.resolution: Standardized token storage key to dippie_auth_token across mediaService.ts, catalogService.ts, and series/[id]/page.tsx with exported getStoredAuthToken(). Added AbortController cleanup in series/[id]/page.tsx on asset/episode switches. Blocked stream with visible alert banner on protected media grant failure without silent unprotected fallback.
tests: frontend npm run build (8 routes compiled successfully)

R3.title: Canonical float/double serialization parity between Java Jackson and Python json across golden vectors
R3.resolution: Implemented formatDouble in CatalogImportService matching Python json.dumps float formatting (covering scientific notation 1e-08, 1e+20, negative zero -0.0, subnormal 0.0001, standard decimal 1.5). Wrapped float/double nodes in JsonNodeFactory.instance.rawValueNode(new RawValue(formatDouble(...))). Verified 100% hash parity on 10 diverse golden vectors.

R4.title: Candidate index object separation and durable storage failure isolation
R4.resolution: Separated candidate index build from active index in FastAPI main.py. Reordered execution to persist durable state via _save_sync_state BEFORE mutating active index or catalog manager references. Verified that durable storage failure (e.g. OSError) leaves active index and catalog manager 100% untouched on baseline generation.

R5.title: Drive real containment in bounded executor
R5.resolution: Implemented validateRealContainment(Path rootPath, Path targetPath) inside DriveMediaStorageAdapter using toRealPath() inside DriveIoExecutor.executeMetadata with bounded timeout (5000ms).
tests: backend/springboot mvn test (178/178 tests passed, BUILD SUCCESS)

R6.title: Real regression evidence without hardcoded pass flags or runtime-state pollution
R6.resolution: Replaced hardcoded assertions with dynamic equality evaluations. Restored original F03 evidence files. Implemented hermetic offline rehearsal probe CATALOG_01_F05_rehearsal.py running on isolated temporary directories with automatic cleanup. Generated cryptographic evidence integrity file CATALOG_01_F05_integrity.json.

P1_admin_import.details: Admin login -> Upload JSON dippie.catalog.v1 -> Dry-run preview with schema validation & diff counters -> Atomic 12-table import -> Scheduled worker syncs via HTTP to FastAPI with canonical SHA-256 hash.

P2_worker_http_sync.details: Worker HTTP sync with canonical hash protocol -> Monotonic generation advance -> Atomic candidate build and swap -> Outbox status transitions to READY.

P3_search_retrieval.details: Multi-tier hybrid search across series, episodes, segments, and scenes -> Direct scene seek at startMs/1000 -> Logical segment seek via coverage interval -> CineBot grounded NLU discovery.

P4_playback_protection.details: HTML5 player streaming -> Public video direct stream (HTTP 206) -> Protected video authenticated via asset-bound Playback Grant Token (5-minute TTL, GET/HEAD only) -> Scope locked against bearer misuse.

P5_restart_durability.details: FastAPI sync state persisted on disk (data/indices/catalog_sync_state.json) and restored on startup -> Spring Boot orphan snapshot recovery on ApplicationReadyEvent -> Multi-package incremental updates supported.
